title: What King Oliver's band was called
summary: JCH knows only that it was King Oliver's band.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: When you were with King Oliver, was that called the Dixie Syncopators then?
Well, I don't know. The only thing I know was the man was King Oliver.
You don't know the name or what they called the band, though?
They said he was the greatest, one of the greatest trumpet players but I don't know nothing else about him -- just King Oliver's band.
